params.text:
[Intro]
*(instrumental)*

[Verse]
Through the storm and the raging sea
Crimson sail flies wild and free
On a cursed shore where black winds moan
Freydis the Red comes riding on by
Down the old road that leads below
A burden dragged down below
An ancient temple waits up ahead
The Heartstone waits unclaimed

[Chorus]
Heart of fire and the light of the mortal fate
Power beyond
the mortal state held fast within
So lock it safely below
where the dark and cold seas roll on
Let her wisdom
guide both her ship and her soul through the storm
A heart of fire still burns
to light the way to her fate

[Interlude]
*(instrumental)*

[Verse]
Then thunder rolls through forest deep
Blackthorn comes with cannon roar
Freydis, you followed me all too late
The Heartstone's mine, not yours to claim
Steel meets steel in the pouring rain
Cutlass flashing for the kill
Till at last Blackthorn falls, his dying eyes
Fire and smoke roll all around

[Chorus]
Heart of fire and the light of the mortal fate
Power beyond
her mortal state held fast within forever
to light the way to her fate

[Interlude]
*(instrumental)*

[Verse]
Three shots of thunder shake the whole ground
Ancient doors torn apart
Freydis reaches the temple's heart
Down through the silent halls
Where the dead still sleep, never waking
She finds the throne
Of a pirate king lost beneath the tides
Where dead kings still keep guard
A cold blue fire that nobody knows
She takes the stone
The Heartstone of the land, from the dead king's hand
Freydis the Red sails on

[Outro]
*(instrumental)*
